texts.preamble: The Beanz Cafe vs The State Of Telangana on 22 September, 2025 The Honourable Sri Justice N.V.Shravan Kumar Writ Petition No.28684 of 2025 Order:
texts.facts: 2. This writ petition has been filed seeking the following prayer:- "to declare the inaction of the Respondent No.5 in not considering the Petitioner's representation dated 17.09.2025 and coming for inspection of smoking area in accordance with the COTPA (Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003), as well as allowing the petitioner herein to serve hookah to his clientele in the cafe named "The Bcenz Caf" having its premises at Plot No.108, NYN Arcade, Lumbini Avenue, Next to E, Gachibowli, Gachibowli, Serilingampally, Rangareddy, 500032." 3. Brief facts stated in this writ petition are that petitioner is a coffee shop running under name and style "The Beanz Cafe", having its premises at Plot No.108, NYN Arcade, Lumbini Avenue, Next to E, Gachibowli, Gachibowli, Serilingampally, Rangareddy, 500032. The petitioner submits that it has obtained required permits including trade license and registration certificate from Labour Department, Government of Telangana. It is further submitted that as per the COTPA Act, the petitioner coffee shop has a designated space/area for the purpose of smoking as well as the same is under CCTV surveillance. The case of the petitioner is that on 17.09.2025, petitioner made a representation and requested respondent No.5 to inspect the subject property and permit the petitioner to serve hookah to his customers. However, the same is still pending. Aggrieved by the same, this writ petition is filed.
texts.arguments: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioner restricts his prayer seeking a direction to respondent authorities to dispose the petitioner's representation dated 17.09.2025 and pass appropriate orders. 5. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home appearing for respondents submits that if the petitioner's representation dated 17.09.2025 is still pending for consideration; the respondent authorities may be directed to dispose of the said representation and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law. a separate area with appropriate enclosure in the hotel premises and no other area or portion of the premises shall be used by the customers of the petitioner for smoking hookah." 8. It is also relevant to refer to the common order dated 15.11.2023 passed in W.P.Nos.8223 of 2013 and batch, relevant portion is extracted hereunder:- "ii) Since the Hyderabad City Police Act, 1348 Fasli confers power over the amusement Centres/restaurants which are defined as "public place" under the COTP Act and as per Rule 4 of the Prohibition of Smoking in Public Places Rules, 2008 permission is required specifying smoking area.
